prompt: Original 3D editorial cover with no text: an abstract work week represented by five connected day cards in a clear horizontal 16:9 composition. Each matte card carries only a distinct geometric state, never words or numbers: a repeating loop for repetition, a suspended gap for waiting, a divergent piece for exception, and a balanced junction for human decision; the fifth card connects the sequence without adding a new category. Airy isometric diorama, simplified geometric forms, matte and softly translucent materials, paper-cream background, soft light from the upper left. Use the Memlia palette visibly and faithfully: cream #fcfbf7 as the dominant field, green #27b657, deep green #1c8a41, and ink #231f20 as accents. No readable text, letters, numbers, logo, faces, people, client data, clock, stopwatch, ranking, dashboard, interface, red alert, or automatic-send symbol.

brief.sujet: Une semaine abstraite découpée en quatre états de flux.
brief.composition: Cinq cartes de jours reliées, avec un état de flux par carte.
brief.interdits: Aucun texte lisible, logo, visage, donnée client, chronomètre ou classement individuel.
brief.alt: Semaine fictive répartie entre répétition, attente, exception et décision humaine
